method: Ran the lesson FakePlanner fixture and required exact stdout equality with its adjacent text fence; tested one-shot rewrite fan-out/deduplication and fallback on malformed/nonterminal output, iterative planner protocol/evidence passing, search-budget exhaustion, and compiled both Python fences; manually reviewed the cited Adaptive-RAG and Self-RAG primary papers.
limitations: The local FakePlanner and keyword lookup demonstrate host control flow only; they do not measure model retrieval decisions, relevance, answer quality, or production behavior.

The 2026-10-08 three-arm results, token totals, call counts, and two reported traces lack raw queries, corpus version, evidence labels, request/response traces, aggregation rules, and scorer; they were not reproduced.
Adaptive-RAG and Self-RAG support descriptions of those research methods in their own evaluated settings; they do not establish a universal strategy or validate the historical local comparison.
